A US lab reaches AGI in 2026–27, bringing record GDP growth alongside mass displacement of knowledge workers, a looming debt spiral, congressional gridlock and rising unrest. China dominates AI-powered manufacturing and blocks US robotics inputs.

## Social contract scores (draft)

| Promise | Score | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Hard work pays | 2 | Junior workers in entry-level knowledge work, law, software and finance are displaced fast, leaving a generation without career pathways, though US hardware automation is blocked. |
| Affordable essentials |  | Not addressed: consumer spending falls, but the report says nothing on the cost of housing, food, energy or care. |
| Reliable safety net | 1 | Income-tax revenue falls as needs rise, a debt spiral looms and government may be unable to fund basic services, let alone an expanded safety net. |
| Responsive government | 2 | Congress is gridlocked, radicalisation rises and government depends on lab self-reporting while firm power risks capturing democratic governance. |
| Time for what matters |  | Not addressed: shorter working weeks and the search for meaning appear only as player proposals, not in the scenario. |
